title: Infer First Tuple Element
description:
Implement a `First<T>` type that extracts the first element type from a tuple.

Also implement `Last<T>` that extracts the last element type, and `Tail<T>` that returns the tuple without its first element.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = First<[number, string, boolean]>  // number
type B = Last<[number, string, boolean]>   // boolean
type C = Tail<[number, string, boolean]>   // [string, boolean]
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using T[0] for First (works for arrays but not tuples with infer). The spread rest pattern with infer is the idiomatic solution for tuple manipulation.
